nodes.title: Rules
nodes.desc:
Zaps only READ from ProspectBoss and Time Doctor.
The API key lives in the Zap (Webhooks header), never in Slack or chat.
Claude posts only in the ISA channel; answers only Tara (Miguel while testing).
